task: Track A: scratch sequence encoder from random init, human original-train genes only, gene-level Score_E

candidates.description: small 400bp CNN; gene-balanced single-promoter training (one promoter per gene per epoch, deterministic rotation); gene-mean inference over all promoters
candidates.trunk: identical Trunk(out_dim=128): conv1(4->64,k7) + conv2(64->64,k5) + conv3(64->128,k5), BatchNorm+ReLU
candidates.readout: global-mean over position -> Linear(128,1) per promoter; gene score = mean of promoter scalars

candidates.description: matched-capacity gene-bag CNN; up to 4 promoters/gene with deterministic rotation at train; concat(mean,max) embedding pooling -> Linear(256,1)
candidates.readout: per-gene concat(mean,max) over promoter embeddings -> Linear(256,1); inference uses ALL promoters

candidates.description: CONDITIONAL dual 400bp/2kb context; ONLY run if initial train-inner evidence supports broader context

selection_rule: max inner-val gene E Spearman (train-inner 90/10 gene holdout, seed 20261011); tie -> larger LR; guardrail: report S/B unchanged (E-only)
inner_split: deterministic 90/10 gene holdout of 46618 train genes, seed 20261011

seeds.note: replication only for promising candidate + matched baseline if time permits; do NOT claim 3-seed robustness if partial

baseline: sequence-feature ridge (mono/dinuc/GC/length on sym400+up2000, gene-mean aggregation) on exact same train genes, train-inner alpha selection
no_repeat_tuning_note: original val/test are frozen and evaluated ONLY after selection manifest is saved; final assessment is retrospective
exposure_tracking: known-donor-unexposed subsets computed via donor_exposure_sets (2241 test / 2289 val genes exposed)
